about: A page of a document with the passage that matters written out and highlighted line by line as it is read, the rest of the page as grey lines, and a note beside it: a clause of a contract, a line of a law, a finding in a paper, a sentence in a letter.

where.about: how far down the page the passage sits, 0 to 1

note.about: a note written beside the passage

when.about: moments the highlighting starts and the note arrives; else when they are said, or one after another
